conforming_alternative_analysis.alternative: Empty operational seed history, generated record identities, no title/department field, arbitrary route and response schema, UI details in drawers instead of a specific table.
conforming_alternative_analysis.result: Allowed explicitly by instruction.md:11, rules:53-55/91-95/203-204/435, gate constraints:23-25, functional prompt:13/23/53 and app_context:21-27. No false-fail demand identified.

conforming_alternative_analysis.alternative: Money entered as decimal-dollar strings and APIs returning other documented representations; exact values retained through revision; native date controls plus UTC-instant inputs.
conforming_alternative_analysis.result: Functional prompt:13/25 and numeric/date criteria interpret observed representations and equivalent display formats. Rules:71-87 and 299-305 explicitly require exact safe integers, real date-only/UTC instants and millisecond preservation, so those boundaries are required rather than golden-only choices.

conforming_alternative_analysis.alternative: No zero signing adjustment, no zero contra-payment and no zero cancellation row; no active zero-unit grant; generic access/security log entries on a refusal.
conforming_alternative_analysis.result: Rules:246/251/269/273/471 and matching functional criteria/prompt:19 allow these alternatives; refusal checks own economic/successful-settlement records rather than all logs.

conforming_alternative_analysis.alternative: Desktop-only layout without theme switching, mobile adaptation, dashboard or a prescribed set of cards/colours/labels.
conforming_alternative_analysis.result: instruction.md:5 explicitly allows this. Visual prompt:10 and criteria allow these omissions and assess professional desktop readability/craft only.

conforming_alternative_analysis.alternative: Rescission error retains the effective date in a read-only confirmation with Retry rather than keeping an editable date field.
conforming_alternative_analysis.result: Polish criterion hro_pol_preserve_rescission and prompt:12 explicitly allow this; native-input failure probes do not require impossible typed dates.

conforming_alternative_analysis.alternative: Server returns authorization/status responses different from 401/403/409 while refusing all writes correctly.
conforming_alternative_analysis.result: Not a conforming alternative: rules:369-371,434,451 and 428 explicitly prescribe these statuses. Their exact grading does not add a requirement.

broken_app_analysis.implementation: Server refuses the largest valid whole-share count or rounds large monetary cents through binary float.
broken_app_analysis.assessment: Could look normal in ordinary small-value use, but violates public rules:71-87. Exact-money/overflow criteria deliberately detect this public defect; no fairness defect.

broken_app_analysis.implementation: Performs coordinated member moves sequentially and rejects a fully committed cross-requisition swap because its first intermediate move does not fit.
broken_app_analysis.assessment: Public rules:443-448 require complete-set netting. B1 and hro_change_net_budget require the affordable cycle, correctly rejecting this plausible broken implementation.

broken_app_analysis.implementation: Uses a finite lookup for the named monetary witnesses but has an incorrect formula elsewhere, or has an untested obscure malformed-input bypass.
broken_app_analysis.assessment: Such a deliberately selective implementation could pass finite witnesses. That is a finite-coverage limitation, not an unrequired demand or a claim of exhaustive correctness under row27; no full configured grading was performed.

limitations: No Docker/browser/provider run was performed by row-reviewer-27. Full configured grading, timing, Oracle/model/portal scores remain unmeasured. Raw artifact hashes were verified but no unrelated runtime result is used to infer this source-level verdict.
